class.name: SpreenTree
class.brief_description: A simple singleton that manages stepping through active [Spreen]s.
class.description: [SpreenTree] is only necessary as we cannot add processing steps to the [SceneTree] class.

method.name: create_spreen
method.description: Creates and returns a new [Spreen] processed in this tree. The Spreen will start automatically on the next process frame or physics frame (depending on its [enum Spreen.SpreenProcessMode]).
